text:
alex_support: Customer on private deploy hitting consistent 403 when uploader tries to PUT the debug package to our presign URL. Requested their env: collector v0.9.2, private control plane 1.18.2.

tara_oncall: can you post the request-id from the failed upload and the exact curl they ran? 403 could be S3 ACL or clock skew. :eyes:

alex_support: request-id=rcp-9f7a3c2, they pasted this curl: `curl -v -X PUT "https://presign.redwood.example/signed?X-Amz-Signature=xxx" -T debug-package.tar.gz -H "Content-Type: application/gzip"`

priya_engineer: curious — are they using the collector's builtin presign uploader or doing manual PUT? if builtin, the collector should do a POST with form fields. Which collector command did they run?

alex_support: they used the collector CLI: `collector collect --upload presign --redact auto --out debug-package.tar.gz` then `collector upload debug-package.tar.gz --presign-url "$URL"`

james_sre: infra-bot pasted a S3 error snippet earlier: `SignatureDoesNotMatch` and `x-amz-request-id: 45B2EXAMPLE`. That usually points to canonical string mismatch (content-md5/ctype) or modified headers. Did the collector add extra headers?

priya_engineer: also check time sync on the host. If clock skew > 5m presigned URLs can fail. Ask the customer to run `date -u` and paste output.

alex_support: asked for date, they replied: `Mon Mar 22 19:04:12 UTC 2026` (ours is 19:03:58). They also sent the collector logs snippet: `upload_request: presign PUT, headers: {Content-Type: application/gzip, x-redwood-redact: true}` and error `403 Forbidden: SignatureDoesNotMatch`.

priya_engineer: aha — presigned PUT expects exactly the headers that were used to generate the signature. We signed with only Content-Type; the collector added x-redwood-redact header which breaks signature. Two remediation paths: 1) use the collector's built-in presign flow (it will POST with form fields) OR 2) regenerate presign that includes the extra header.

alex_support: customer says they were forcing manual upload because their firewall blocks multipart POST to the presign host. They asked for a fallback.

james_sre: options: a) give them a short-lived S3 direct presign that allows the extra header, b) provide an scp/rsync fallback to our ingest gateway (we have ports 2222 open for uploads), c) suggest collector v0.9.3 which strips x-redwood-* header in presign mode.

alex_support: i'll offer collector v0.9.3 binary and a one-off presign with header allowance. will also request a curl repro with `-i -v` and full response headers.

tara_oncall: add repro checklist in thread: request-id, collector logs (tail -n 200), `collector version`, `date -u`, full curl -i -v, presign URL (redact query string but keep host/path), and whether they can try scp to uploads.redwood.example:2222. :white_check_mark:

priya_engineer: small note for support doc — include a snippet to reproduce signature mismatch locally: ```
# reproduce local mismatch
curl -v -X PUT "https://presign..." -T debug-package.tar.gz -H "Content-Type: application/gzip" -H "x-redwood-redact: true"
```

alex_support: customer agreed to try v0.9.3 and to run the curl -i -v. i'll post back logs once they test. thanks all. :pray:

infra-bot: Uploaded diagnostic hook: dlog-1950126789 attached (collector logs redacted per policy).
